title: Svelte Action (Popup)
firstSteps: Run npm run dev to launch the extension
Click the toolbar icon to open the action popup
Edit src/action/ActionApp.svelte and save to watch it update
useCases: Toolbar popup rendered by Svelte as the primary UI surface
Quick actions that update the toolbar badge from the popup
Starting point for Svelte extensions with a popup

store.summary: Adds a toolbar popup to the browser with a simple Svelte page.
versionHistory: 1.0.0 (unreleased): initial version from the action-svelte template. Not yet submitted to any store.
